title: YouTube First 10 Videos Growth & View Distribution Study
sourceTitle: What Happens When You Post Your First 10 Videos on YouTube
sampleDescription: 448,413 YouTube channels created in early 2025 that published at least 10 long-form videos or 10 Shorts during their initial 90 days
limitations: Tracks only channels that persisted to upload at least 10 videos (excludes channels abandoned after 1–3 uploads)
Views recorded after 30 days of publication
Does not isolate creator prior experience or off-platform traffic drivers
